title: Nintendo Music Discs
description: Craftable Music Discs of songs available on the Nintendo Music app
body:
## OVERVIEW

Collect and craft items to make brand new music discs of songs available on the Nintendo Music streaming app!

### SOUNDTRACKS

* Donkey Kong Country
* Animal Crossing: New Leaf
* Pokémon Scarlet & Violet
* Donkey Kong Bananza

## NOTES
- This mod was reworked from the ground up in the transition to a general Nintendo Music mod. Old saves may be incompatible with the current version.
- You are free to use this mod in your modpack!
- The music in this mod may not 100% reflect how it appears on the Nintendo Music app.
- You can share any issues or feedback you may have on my [Discord server.](https://discord.gg/qNaytwaJcV)
